title: Sources
intro: Upload papers and notes for the AI to answer from. Its answers cite the passages they use.
accepted: PDF, Word (.docx), plain text or Markdown, up to {size} each.
viewerNotice: Only editors and owners can upload or remove sources.
duplicate: Already in this workspace as “{existing}”, so it was not processed again.
tooLargeHere: Larger than the {size} upload limit, so it was not sent.
emptyText: Uploaded files appear here while they are read, and are ready for the AI once they are.
permanent: Trying again will not help with this file.
deleteMessage: {name}, its passages and the stored file will be removed. Answers that cited it will show the citation as unavailable.
